question: Among adults with hypertension, does home blood pressure monitoring with remote team support, compared with usual follow-up, reduce clinic systolic blood pressure at 12 weeks?

pico.population: Adults with hypertension in a wholly synthetic trial scenario
pico.intervention: Home blood pressure monitoring with remote team review and support
pico.comparator: Usual clinic follow-up without the remote support program

eligible_designs: Parallel randomized two-arm trials with independent participants
inclusion_criteria: Matched 12-week clinic systolic BP endpoint in mmHg
Between-group mean difference with an extractable confidence interval
exclusion_criteria: Nonrandomized comparisons for this specified trial-only scenario
Different primary follow-up without an eligible 12-week endpoint
Overlapping participant cohort already represented by a selected effect

outcome.name: clinic_sbp_mmhg
outcome.direction: Intervention minus control; negative values favor lower systolic BP under remote support

sensitivity_plan: Inspect consistency of endpoint definition, participant overlap and effect direction before synthesis
